turns.customer: Can I return the boots from order #1053? I wore them once on a short hike and they're just not for me.
turns.reply: That's a bummer — I can't return the Ridgeline Mid Hiking Boots from order #1053. Our policy only accepts unused items in their original condition, and since you've worn them on a hike, they don't qualify. If there were any defects, the warranty may cover it — I'm happy to have a team member look into that. Otherwise I can point you to our shopping team to find something that fits better. Sorry I can't be more help on the return itself.
